Its Choi rank is three or four, according as the remaining scalar has unit modulus or strict modulus below one. Proof. The Hermitian kernel is one-dimensional and contains a nonzero traceless matrix because the map is trace preserving. Diagonalize it. The two diagonal input projectors then have the same output ρ, which is faithful. Writing the off-diagonal response as C gives Φ(X) = (x + w)ρ + yC + zC†. Choi positivity is equivalent to
